{{Quote|I never thought I'd see the day when you cowered in ''safety''&mdash;while your little Padawan faced certain ''death''.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Keep the Faith!" />}}
The '''Battle of Taronda''' took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were sent by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to negotiate a trading agreement with the miners of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for raw materials for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Before negotiations could start however, the planet was attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. Outnumbering the Republic forces, the Separatists had them pinned down under their own [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. The Republic forces were however saved by the arrival of a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator-''class Star Destroyer]] with reinforcements.
